name: What is the process for improving floor level transitions?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for improving floor level transitions?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an assessment to determine the cause and extent of the height difference. Next, the area is prepared, which may involve removing existing flooring or subfloor components. Depending on the issue, the subfloor might be leveled using self-leveling compounds or by installing additional underlayment. Finally, appropriate transition pieces are installed to bridge the gap smoothly and securely between the two floor heights. Our team ensures proper adhesion and finish for durability.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves assessment, subfloor preparation and leveling, then installing appropriate transition pieces to bridge the height difference smoothly.
